name: Production rollback success rate
definition: Share of rollbacks initiated after an actual production change failure that restore the approved last-known-good state and pass verification within RTO.
formula: count(distinct change_id where rollback_verified=true within RTO) / count(distinct change_id with production_rollback_initiated=true)

numerator.definition: Distinct failed production changes whose first rollback completed, restored the approved last-known-good state and passed independent verification within 30 minutes.

denominator.definition: All distinct production changes with an initiated rollback after an actual failure; timed-out, canceled and partially completed rollbacks remain in the denominator and count as failures.

exclusions: scheduled drills with trigger=drill (reported separately as rollback_drill_success)
duplicate retries for the same change_id (retained as attempt evidence, not extra denominator units)

data_source.system: Change controller and AgentOps event lake
data_source.query: Aggregate the first terminal rollback result by change_id; PASS only when completed_at-initiated_at <= 30 minutes and independent verification_passed=true

alert.condition: any production rollback failure OR rolling 30d ratio < 1.0 after minimum_sample

confidence.decision_rule: Operational PASS requires zero failures and denominator >= 5; report the one-sided exact upper bound for failures and never describe finite samples as proof of 100% future reliability.
